name: The Lady Mayor's Show
summary: London's big day out. All the atmosphere of the traditional parade that always brings fun and colour to the city's streets.

name: Heist: Robbing the Bank of England
summary: Heist: Robbing the Bank of England documents the 1990 Bank of England bond heist which saw a theft of £ 292 million. Hosted my Marcel Theroux, this series will travel across the globe to tell this incredible true story which spanned several continents over three decades, leaving many unanswered questions…until now.

name: Chaos Uncut
summary: In Chaos Uncut, the action never stops. Get ready for high-speed chases, shocking crashes, and lives hanging in the balance.

name: Original Gangsters with Sean Bean
summary:
From Al Capone, to the real Peaky Blinders, from The Krays twins to the Queen of Harlem, each episode of Original Gangsters will see the legendary actor Sean Bean take a deep dive through a rogues' gallery of some of the most notorious criminals in history to separate the fact from the fiction, as we find out what they mean to us today and just why they were the original gangsters.

This series will fuse cinematic reenactment, expert talking head interviews and the latest technology to bring these infamous characters to life, like never before. We will hear from some of the world's leading experts and the people who knew them personally to find out from them just what made each of these extraordinary characters tick.

name: Battle Treasures with Foxy and Bruce
summary:
Battle Treasures with Foxy and Bruce tells the stories behind some of the rarest and most remarkable military artefacts ever discovered.

Hosted by Jason Fox and Bruce Crompton, each episode explores three extraordinary items - revealing their provenance, the battlefield stories behind them, and little-known facts to bring each object to life.

Bruce brings his encyclopaedic knowledge to each item while Jason draws on his experience as one of Britain's most elite soldiers to offer vivid, first-hand context. The series also delivers world firsts, revealing artefacts never seen by the public.

name: Steam Train Diaries
summary: Paul 'Piglet' Middleton journeys through the picturesque North York Moors National Park onboard heritage steam engines, and discovers what it takes to keep this iconic line running.

name: Кому на Руси
summary: To Whom in Russia is a new criminal podcast. The project is aimed at a detailed study of the phenomenon of the criminal world through the dialogues of the hosts with invited guests, experts, law enforcement officers, families and gang members. As well as all those who come into contact with him in Russia and the CIS countries.

previousepisode.name: ОПГ ДЕСЯТКА – КОРОЛИ УЛИЦ / Фауст, Виктор Щетков, Олег Архипов

name: FBoy Island: Germany
summary: FBoy Island—the reality dating show with Lola Weippert and Love Island star Aurelia! Three single ladies meet 20 hot guys for a man test in the Caribbean. But only half of them are nice guys who mean well – the others are FBoys! Will the ladies choose the good guys? Or will the €50,000 jackpot go to the heartbreakers?

name: Abdullahpur Ka Devdas
summary: Set in a small town, revolves around Fakhar and Kashif, two best friends unknowingly in love with the same woman, Gulbano.

name: The Claman Countdown: Power Players
summary: A lineup of innovators and decision makers, from Jensen Huang, the visionary behind Nividia's $4 trillion chip empire to James Quincey, the driving force at Coca-Cola and billionaire investor Ray Dalio; Liz Claman reveals how these CEOs shape industries and fuel growth.

name: Yesterday
summary: Veir, heir of VPG Group, meets Kelvin, the second son of KING Group, and helps him fight for power against his half-brother Ken. After being betrayed and fleeing to Chiang Mai with Nana's help, one day, Veir reunites with Kelvin. Together, they must face Ken, now married to Lalin and ruling LOYDE Group, with their lives on the line.

name: Terrazza Sentimento
summary: One of Milan's most exclusive parties takes a dark turn when a woman reports sexual assault. This documentary chronicles the investigation that followed.

name: Madam & Eve
summary: Based on the Madam & Eve comic strip, this sitcom reflects on the showdowns between "madam" (Val Donald Bell) and her domestic worker, Eve (Tina Jaxa). It reaches across racial boundaries with humour in post-apartheid South Africa.

name: Eric Lapointe
summary: Revealing the man behind the persona, this documentary traces the career of the singer, from successes to excesses and media scandals.

name: Hippo Watch with Steve Backshall
summary: Steve Backshall is in search of the only wild animal that fills him with fear - the hippo - known for their lethal aggression. Steve heads to South Africa's Ndumo game reserve to find out what fuels their behaviour, and uncovers some of their surprising traits. He walks their pathways, dives into their waterways and uses the latest technology to let viewers glimpse into their secret world.

name: Tell Me What You Really Think
summary: Marc Fennell throws a very different kind of dinner party, inviting extraordinary Australians facing some of the most important health issues of today to tell him what they really think.

name: From the Ashes of World War II
summary: Explores how the cities that were attacked, damaged and destroyed during World War II rose again and were rebuilt in a new world.

name: A Rebel Education: Inside Carrigaline Community School
summary: The new series offers an unfiltered and emotional look at life inside a modern Irish secondary school showcasing the trials and tribulations of teen life filmed over the course of an academic year in Cork.

name: Dinner with the Enemy
summary: Ten radically different dinner guests are served the hottest societal talking points and divisive moral dilemmas. As perceived enemies break bread, can they find common ground?

name: Heat My Home
summary: Building engineer Kieran McCarthy is travelling around Ireland, checking out homes that are getting energy upgrades.

name: Oíche Shamhna: An Ancient Mystery
summary: Exploring mythology, archaeology and science, this series reveals Halloween's ancient origins in Ireland.

name: Find My Beach House
summary: A captivating series that follows host Shelley Craft as she leads couples on a house-hunting adventure along Australia's stunning coastline.

name: Safe Houses
summary: Safe Houses is a fast-paced international espionage thriller set in the aftermath of the killing of a high-ranking CIA officer in Madrid. The series follows Sofia Jiménez, a fugitive agent accused of the crime, and Ambassador Elizabeth Winters, his widow, as they each investigate the murder from opposite sides, unraveling a vast conspiracy that could upend the balance of global power.

name: Snooki: Paranormal Rookie
summary: Snooki: Paranormal Rookie pairs Snooki's unfiltered charisma and genuine belief in the supernatural with the expertise of Kevin Whitaker, one of Canada's foremost psychic mediums. With zero formal training but a whole lot of determination, Snooki embarks on a transformational journey from wide-eyed rookie to confident investigator, culminating in her first solo investigation at a famously haunted Canadian location.

name: iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina
summary: iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina, the iconic event celebrating the best of Latin music with a night of unforgettable performances, special guests, and vibrant Latin culture.

name: Cherry Lane Trilogy
summary:
The Cherry Lane Trilogy (and the associated fourth film, "Deck the Halls on Cherry Lane") are a series of interconnected Hallmark movies that explore different family stories across various timelines, all centered around a single house at 7 Cherry Lane

The series follows multiple families and their holiday experiences, spanning different eras, and shows how their stories are connected through the house. Each movie stands on its own while adding to the larger narrative of the house and the people who live there.

previousepisode.name: Deck the Halls on Cherry Lane

name: Time-lapse Japan
summary: Shimizu Daisuke investigates various aspects of Japanese culture and traditions, using the technique of time-lapse photography.

name: Botched Homes
summary: The most jaw-dropping, head-scratching failed renovations won't deter New York City turned Florida contractor Charlie Kawas and his expert crew in Botched Homes (Monument LLC), slated for 2026. Fed up with disastrous work that leads to unsafe, unlivable and unbelievable homes, Charlie will make it his mission to fix what others got horribly wrong in the eight one-hour episodes. Whether it's inferior craftsmanship, wonky layouts or mind-boggling finishes—think doors and stairs that lead to nowhere, cabinets that don't open and hideous design choices—Charlie and his team will right the wrongs of shoddy contractors and DIY projects gone awry, bringing function, flow and beauty to clients' spaces in disrepair.

name: Neighborhood Watch
summary: Neighborhood Watch, revealing the raw, unfiltered and sometimes shocking footage straight from security cameras, smart doorbells, nanny cams and baby monitors across America. From neighbors and postal workers to uninvited guests and animal visitors, the network will tap into the hilarious, outrageous and downright bizarre moments caught on home surveillance video.

name: World's Bargain Dream Homes
summary: This newest house hunting series will inspire adventurous buyers to dream big and buy low in World's Bargain Dream Homes. The authentic, entertaining and humorous 12 episodes will follow people brave enough to purchase the world's most affordable properties that also happen to be stunning, turnkey and in desirable locations around the globe, many of which offer incredible cost-saving incentives.

name: Property Brothers: Under Pressure
summary: Home reno and real estate powerhouse duo Drew and Jonathan Scott will star in and executive produce a new 14-episode series Property Brothers: Under Pressure, which will spotlight the dynamic twins as they help wary buyers grappling with commitment issues make confident, informed decisions for the biggest purchase of their lives. With the emotional and financial stakes at an all-time high, the Scott Brothers will guide clients through the highs and lows of the home buying process—from fiercely competitive markets and sticker shock to personal wish lists and tough compromises—and then incorporate stunning, smart and functional design solutions into renovations that create their dream homes.

name: Inside the World's Most Luxurious…
summary:
Inside the World's Most Luxurious… is a new factual series from Crackit TV that grants viewers an exclusive glimpse into the world's most extraordinary destinations and experiences — truly revealing how the other half live.

Viewers will be invited to step through the gilded doors of a secretive world of extreme luxury, where the ultra-rich buy, charter and revel in experiences most of us can only dream of.

Narrated by Tracy-Ann Oberman, Inside the World's Most Luxurious... will unveil the artistry, service and attention-to-detail that elevate these experiences beyond imagination. Each of the six episodes focuses on a different facet of super-rich life, from island escapes and palatial hotels to multi-million-pound motorhomes, superyachts, and even bespoke travel as far away as space.

With staggering price tags at every turn, Inside the World's Most Luxurious... opens the doors to a world few ever see, lifting the lid on how the wealthiest people on earth really live, travel and unwind.

name: Race Around The World
summary:
In a time defined by fast-paced narratives and global connection, Race Around the World returns both as a homage to its original spirit and a bold reimagining. It celebrates the raw power of authentic, on-the-ground storytelling and the boundless curiosity that fuels it.

The revival of the much-loved format is set to deliver fresh perspectives, discover new creative talent and reaffirm the ABC's commitment to original Australian content.

name: Decision 2025
summary: See: https://www.tvmaze.com/shows/79469/ms-now-special-coverage

name: Never Forget Your Enemy
summary: After a car accident, Gi Ha Neul wakes up at age 29 with only the memories of his 19-year-old self, losing an entire decade of his life. The biggest shock comes when he learns that during those missing years, he was in a seven-year relationship with his lifelong rival, Yeo Sae Byeok. While photos, messages, and even his own instincts suggest they were deeply in love, Ha Neul remembers him only as the enemy who overshadowed him throughout childhood. As fragments of memory slowly return, he begins to suspect that their relationship ended for a reason and that Sae Byeok may be hiding the truth.

name: Police in Love
summary:
Marry me? Just six months and we'll be divorced. 

Inspector Thiartha's mother gives him an ultimatum. To counteract his bad luck, he'll have to marry someone born Monday, the thirteenth of October. As if that weren't hard enough, their first and last names must contain the Thai consonant ro ruea. Turns out that his junior, Police Senior Sergeant Major Mangkorn, was born on exactly that day, name as prescribed, perfect to the last item.

name: Be My Player Two
summary: Top-streamer Thi hunts down Zo, a mysterious gamer who defeats him. Instead of rivalry, Thi finds warmth and sincerity. As they chase their e-sports dreams, friendship turns into love, proving that the journey matters most.

name: Nour
summary:
In a city shrouded in mist and desire, a series of bizarre arsons begins to unearth secrets buried for decades. James, a hot-blooded young officer chasing a cold case, crosses paths with the enigmatic Captain Ken, intertwining their fates through an unseen force.

Meanwhile, forensic pathologist Jirat and his assistant Chita develop a profound connection as they navigate the fine line between life and death during the investigation.

The deeper they dig, the more they realize these fires are tied to a curse spanning generations. As the truth finally surfaces, love, hate, justice, and corruption will face their ultimate judgment under the crimson moonlight.

name: Magic Lover
summary: Three wizards, Vivian, Deris and Aphere are chosen to fulfil a quest. Every century, citizens of their realm must journey to the ordinary world to discover their true loves. If they fail to complete their mission in thirty days, they'll be transformed into animals for eternity. Fortunately, they'll each have an assistant to help them along the way.

name: Малой
summary: Sasha, an excellent student at the Academy of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, is facing a difficult ordeal — serving in the most disadvantaged area of Yugodonsk. He hopes to find his father there, whom he has never seen, a true legend of the criminal investigation department. However, instead of the exemplary hero, Sasha meets his complete opposite, the "Little One." An experienced operative has long established life in the city on the principle of "live by yourself and let others live" — for the sake of his own convenience, the "Little One" turns a blind eye to minor offenses of local residents. Sasha faces an almost impossible task: to solve complicated cases and re-educate his father, a partner who has long been accustomed to solving everything according to his own rules, and not according to protocol. Will Sasha be able to prove to his father that in their work it is impossible to simultaneously serve the rule of law and negotiate with those who constantly violate it? And most importantly, which will win in the end: the law or your own concept of justice?

name: Save Our Souls (SOS)
summary: Five students from different backgrounds find themselves living together in a campus that has changed substantially since 1994 and become more and more progressive.

name: De Frogers: Groeten Uit...
summary: The Froger family travels to the Black Forest, where they stay at an authentic German farmhouse. The farmhouse serves as a base for various fun, exciting, and unforgettable activities, always imbued with signature Froger humor.

name: Nutuk
summary: Maya and Rami are a young Druze couple whose six-year-old son, Daniel, begins to share details about his previous life. Daniel's story opens a Pandora's box in the lives of his own family and the family in which he says he once lived.

name: Who Hired the Hitman?
summary: Who Hired the Hitman? delves into the twisted trails of phone calls, endless suspects, deceiving alibis, and the hidden motives of murder-for-hire plots.

name: The Family Plan
summary: A former assassin living as a suburban dad is forced to take his unsuspecting family on the run after his past catches up to him, leading them on a spontaneous road trip to Las Vegas. He must protect them from a mysterious threat while trying to keep his true identity a secret during their chaotic journey.

name: Texas Monthly Presents
summary: Texas Monthly has been chronicling the state for more than fifty years, and nobody knows Texas—its characters and complexities—better than the magazine's writers and editors. Texas Monthly Presents is a captivating new docuseries that brings the magazine's award-winning journalism from the page to the screen and invites viewers to experience Texas through the perspective of a storyteller. The inaugural season, titled The Story, immerses viewers in a diverse lineup of stories from across Texas while highlighting journalists' special talents for spotting memorable characters and narratives.

name: STV Children's Appeal
summary: Lorraine Kelly, Sean Batty and Laura Boyd celebrate another year of fundraising.

name: When Death Comes Knocking
summary: In When Death Comes Knocking, each episode follows a homicide investigation where crucial evidence was caught on a Ring-style doorbell or home security footage.

name: Kimi no Iru Machi: Tasogare Kousaten
summary:
Kimi no Iru Machi: Tasogare Kousaten is a prequel to the TV series. This was covered in manga chapters 17 and 18.

After being like worlds apart, Haruto visits Tokyo on a school trip and plans to meet with Yuzuki whom he dated while she was staying at his place last winter. But they miss each other, and Haruto ends up playing Nanami's boyfriend so she can impress her friend. But when Yuzuki sees Haruto and Nanami holding hands at the train station, she misunderstands it and starts thinking that she is the only one trying to invest in this long-distance relationship.

previousepisode.name: 君のいる町 ～黄昏交差点２～

name: Stokvel
summary: The series features the ongoing adventures of a young professional couple and their respective stokvels. It is set in the vibrant and exciting world of stokvels, where friends meet for companionship, good times and a social way of saving money.

name: Outside in: Lost in Academia
summary: Japanese culture is in the global spotlight like never before. Dive into the work of international scholars exploring Japan in bold, original ways, uncovering unique perspectives and deep insights.

name: Going Up
summary: Jabulani works at a South African law firm, serving tea to his elderly yet well-respected boss, lawyer Reginald Cluver. While Cluver excels in legal matters, he is out of touch with the complexities of the world. When the firm takes on eccentric clients, it's Jabulani's cleverness that often leads to practical solutions.

name: Amores Roubados
summary: Leandro returns to the city of Sertão as a sophisticated sommelier. With irresistible charm, he is bold with married women until he is surprised by the young and fearless Antônia.

name: Die Nibelungen - Kampf der Königreiche
summary: In "Hagen," the well-known Nibelungen saga, based on the literary work by Wolfgang Hohlbein, is interpreted somewhat differently.

name: My Chef in Crime
summary: Forensic scientist-turned-chef Chan becomes the prime suspect in his rival chef's mysterious death. He must clear his name, using his deep knowledge of food chemistry and forensic science, and teaming up with fearless investigative police officer Lieutenant Lalit whose past intertwines with his own. Together, they tackle intriguing cases through culinary experiments and create mouth-watering dishes.

name: She's Fiercer Than Gunfire
summary: In Amsterdam's Dragon City Street, Wen Manli is sold to the mafia by her uncle. Because she resembles Chu Zhen, she is asked by Huo Zichen to pose as her double, helping him fight for the gang leadership and rescue his mother. Wen helps Huo defeat A Shu and saves him from prison. Later, Chu Zhen forces a marriage, but when Huo's mother awakens, he rushes to the port to confess his love to Wen — and the two finally stay together.

name: Shadow Detective
summary: In the early 1930s, the mysterious death of a female university student occurred in a dormitory in Shanghai. Detective Guan Cen from the Central Police Department became acquainted with Lu Yizhen, a college student who loved detective novels, as a result of the case. This incident led them to uncover a child kidnapping case that had taken place 17 years earlier. Two years later, Lu Yizhen took part in the recruitment exam for Shanghai's first group of female police officers, with Guan Cen becoming her direct superior. Within the police department, as new cases continued to emerge, the two worked together to reopen the investigation into the child trafficking case, dispersing the fog and nightmares that had long hung over their heads.

name: More than a Childhood Friend
summary: Two longtime childhood friends drift apart when Cheng Xia gives up on her unrequited love, only to reconnect with Xu Jingxiao, another childhood companion, whose sincere pursuit changes her life. As old regrets collide with new romance, she finally finds real love and a fresh start in both career and heart.

name: La Décision
summary: In this riveting race against the clock, the life of the French president is turned upside down when an 8-year-old girl goes missing. While the public is shocked over the disappearance of the young girl, the tragedy affects the president personally as she is his illegitimate daughter, born of a secret affair unknown to his wife and political advisor Nora. When the kidnapping becomes a matter of state, the entire Élysée apparatus intervenes to find the little girl. But who can the president trust behind the closed doors of the palace? He has risen to the pinnacle of power on the strength of his honesty and integrity, but must he betray the very values to which he owes his election? Torn between his private life and public responsibilities, the president is now plunged into a whirlwind of false friendships, unrequited love, power struggles, political games and espionage.

name: Jia Gui Nu Jin Jie Lu
Jiang Jun, Zhe Dun Guan Gou
Chuan Yue Ba Ling, Jiao Huang Ba Ma Nie Yuan
Ai Huan Huan Ba！Wo De Ren Sheng Yi Ru Fan Zhang
Gu Ji Zhang，Tai Tai Shuo Ta Yi Shou Gua San Nian
Fu Shi Xian Yi Bu Ran Chen
summary: When the shattered Divine Mirror releases an ancient evil spirit, Xie Yun, into Yao Yang's body, Bai Xiyin takes him in as her disciple to purify the darkness within. In the process, she sacrifices herself, prompting Yao Yang to embark on a journey to resurrect his fallen master. Joined by mystical companions, he travels across realms to recover her lost soul and uncover the hidden truth behind the mirror's destruction.

name: Where the Mask Ends
summary:
A Chou was originally a lowly young girl who could be trampled and bullied by anyone. Yet, due to her face resembling that of the wealthy heiress Wei Rao of the Hou Mansion, she unexpectedly became the bride of Prince Lu Zuo of the Duke Mansion. A Chou was ambitious and eager to rise to power, but her newlywed husband, who was on the verge of death, suddenly woke up, bringing about a series of misfortunes. Wei Rao hates her for occupying the magpie's nest and is eager to get rid of her quickly; Lu Zuo uses her for his schemes, being extremely cautious and calculating.

The Duke Mansion was openly friendly, but in reality, it was fraught with traps and a deadly threat. Ah Chou steadily and meticulously planned, employing every means to win her husband's devoted love and uncover the secrets of her background. She eventually reunited with her closest family, rising from the bottom to become a dazzling figure in her life!

name: High Horse: The Black Cowboy
summary: This three-part pop culture and historical documentary confronts and reclaims the Wild West while revealing the story of the Black cowboy — a history that has largely been untold.

name: The Party
summary:
Raised alone by his working-class mum, Sylvia, Martin wins a scholarship to an elite boarding school, where he first meets Ben. They forge an unbreakable bond, as Ben and the Fitzmaurice's give Martin the sense of belonging he has always craved. In turn, Martin remains unflinchingly loyal to Ben through even the greatest crises.

Three decades on, Martin is invited to Ben's lavish birthday party at the Fitzmaurice's country pile. The news of the Conservative leader's resignation threatens to derail Ben's party, as he considers announcing his intention to stand. Martin fears the publicity that Ben's bid would bring, dredging up the secrets of their past with tragic consequences …

The drama moves between the shocking events of the party and the police investigation that follows, with flashbacks to Martin and Ben's lives at school, university and London party days.

What unfolds is a gripping exploration of identity, privilege and devotion, combined with a tender ode to anyone who has fought to live authentically.

name: OWN for the Holidays
summary: Now in its seventh year, OWN announces the highly anticipated return of its annual ‘OWN For the Holidays' programming event with three uplifting new movies celebrating the true meaning and warmth of the season: "Fake Yourself a Merry Little Christmas," "The Christmas Showdown" and "Very Merry Mystery."

name: Knot
summary: Phatsa grew up without ever knowing that alphas, betas, and omegas existed in this world. One night, his life was turned upside down when Nakhun, a cold, stern True Alpha and the first heir of a powerful family unexpectedly bit him, forging an unbreakable bond between them. From complete strangers, they are forced to live together under the rules of a bond neither of them can defy. The closer they become, the deeper the connection grows. The stronger the bond, the harder it is to escape. And the most terrifying part is, as fated mates, once their bond is fully completed, if one of them dies, the other will inevitably follow—without any chance of resistance. This is not merely a story of love. It is a tale of a bond that stakes everything—life, heart, and destiny itself.

name: Duang with You
summary: Duang, a student of decorative arts, fell in love with Qin, a music major, from the very first moment they met. Duang chose to move forward with sincerity, doing everything he could to step into Qin's world. On the night of the Loy Krathong festival, Duang finally gathered his courage and confessed all his feelings to Qin. The answer he received was not a rejection, but a simple sentence that quietly opened the door to Qin's heart "Then try winning me over." From that day on, Duang moved forward with all his strength, his heart fully prepared to love Qin. As they grew closer, Qin slowly began to open up, and Duang became the one and only happiness in Qin's life. At the same time, Qin became Duang's safe haven, a place of comfort on the days when he felt exhausted.

name: Your Third
summary: Sam has been secretly in love with someone for years. Just when he finally musters the courage to confess and start a relationship, his older brother, Sib, swoops in and steals the spotlight. He's loved this person for so long, how could anyone expect him to just move on overnight? To nurse his broken heart, he escapes to a remote island in the south, hoping time and distance will heal the wounds. But his well-meaning yet utterly clueless older brother has other plans sending someone to drag him back home. Whether this person is here to retrieve him or just become another headache is still up for debate. Jam is the right-hand man to Sib, a high-powered executive at a top-tier corporation. For the sake of career advancement, he goes above and beyond in his duties. His latest assignment is to locate and retrieve his artistic, angsty younger brother who has quite literally disappeared off the grid. Oh, and he has exactly two weeks to do it. Tracking down Sam is hard enough. Getting him to willingly return? Nearly impossible. Jam is this close to losing it.

name: Mr. Fanboy
summary: University student Wan has a fanboy hobby, following and photographing rising star Nine. When Wan gets a casting opportunity for a support role in a Y series his idol will be starring in, he meets Third, a sharp-tongued leading man and Nine's ship partner. The two clash immediately, but when Wan passes his audition, the two are forced to work together. Despite their dislike for one another, after getting to know Third, Wan starts to look at his rival in a different light. He doesn't know what's wrong with him, but he finds himself avoiding the cocky leading man's gaze more and more often. Beyond that, Wan comes to learn that behind the curtain, the industry that looked so splendid isn't all as he'd thought. Even Nine, his own idol, is hiding something shady.

name: Hug E-Lhee the Musical
summary: Noi, the son of a som tam restaurant owner, is stuck working as a waiter though he dreams of being a singer. When his mother falls ill, she entrusts him with the business. He's soon set an additional challenge when a man from the big city moves into town and opens a rival fusion restaurant.

name: You(r)Tuber
summary: Chopkhun never expected his longtime partner to cheat and take over their YouTube channel. Determined to surpass his ex, he starts anew-first step, building a team. Surprisingly, famed cameraman Intouch applies.

name: Lust
summary: In a world where power can buy lives, everything becomes a game of desire and obsession. Deep dive into lust, money, and raw desire.

name: Peach Lover
summary: The long-awaited return of "Peach Lover" the legendary owner of a hugely popular 18+ sensual account, after a year away from the spotlight, has sent hearts racing once again, especially for Po, a devoted fan who has been hopelessly smitten for years. This time, Peach Lover comes back with a major announcement: the search for a brand-new "peach," someone he can savor fresh, sweet, and juicy on camera. The die-hard fan doesn't hesitate for a second, submitting an application at lightning speed. At last, there's a chance to see the face of the person he's long dreamed of, even if only as a bedmate at work. But who would have thought… despite countless rehearsals between the sheets, they never actually step onto the real stage together. Instead, getting to know each other's true selves draws them closer than either ever expected, so close they can hardly be apart. When will this relationship finally become clear? Or are they destined to remain nothing more than coworkers forever?

name: Dokument inifrån: Golaren
summary: He sells drugs to the Foxtrot network, but refuses to help murder the gang leader's relative. In the midst of the bloody wave of violence, he turns to the police instead. In an apartment with two torpedoes, he bets everything on the task force to intervene. He is the gang member who became a golar. Investigative series by Mattias Sandberg.

name: Love Island Australia Officially Unpacked
summary: You'll finally see Gabby's never-before-seen audition tape… and trust us, it's pure gold. Ex-winners Claudia and Austen join the show. Plus, the producers are in the Hot Seat!

previousepisode.name: Ross & Sharn Grilled In The Hot Seat + Boston Drops Explosive Truth Bombs

name: Сильная ты
summary: Nina Vavilova is a talented guide, she conducts city tours and fights for historical monuments. She's been happily married for a long time. Her husband Artem is Nina's fulcrum and the only person she absolutely trusts. It seems to her that without him she would not be able to live a day. But a tragic accident turns her whole life upside down. One day Artem gets into a car accident together - with his second family-his common-law wife Masha and little daughter Katya.

name: По имени Барон
summary: This is the story about a person born during the time of WW2 evacuation and who quickly turned from a modest Jewish boy Joseph into a cruel and cynical crowned thief, ruthless to everyone. The person, who once lost, forgot, traded his present name by becoming simply a Baron... Streets of modern city are changed into wooden pavements of a provincial town in the beginning of 50th, high society parties are turned into gangsters' meetings, Mediterranean landscapes - into dirty railway stations of Russian suburbs, detective's office of Stalin times - into a high security prison of 70th.

name: Судьба на выбор
summary: Heroes of different social groups and ages try to find a solution to the problem, "living" several options for the development of their destiny, each time returning to the beginning from the same moment, key for a given situation. The heroes will get three attempts to find the correct solution. In this they are helped by two Guardians - Alexander Gordon and Ksenia Lavrova-Glinka, they enjoy their freedom and at the same time envy people a little. In their parallel world there is no time and no physical sensations, but only spirit and thought.

name: Секретная служба Его Величества
summary: In the beginning of the 20th century the Russian Empire faces a new threat - political terrorism. To fight it a new secret service is set up. Experienced agents and detectives oppose the blood-thirsty "revolutionaries" and fanatics.

name: Полосатое счастье
summary: Nine-year-old Petka Odintsov, a smart aleck, has no friends, but he does have his grandmother, Aurora Alexandrovna. In such company, Petka's future is at risk. He has no prospects other than books and lessons. But one day, Petka commits a heroic act, and a tabby cat, Vaska, appears in the Odintsov household. The Odintsovs' lives change dramatically—the grandmother declares war on Vaska.

name: Тёмная лошадка
summary: An unknown group, calling themselves "Temnaya Loshadka" ("Dark Horse") routinely assassinate inconvenient people. Everyone from federal security services to victims' friends and a local policeman try to tackle them.

name: Эффект Матроны
summary:
In any weather, on weekdays and holidays, there's a line at the Pokrovsky Convent: hundreds of women come here, to the relics of Saint Matrona, hoping for a miracle. And miracles do happen! Even 63 years after her death, Matrona of Moscow never misses a single request: terminally ill patients recover, and those desperate to give birth become mothers. In the new documentary series «Effekt Matrony» we'll tell 20 amazing stories that happened to those who turned to the saint for help.

Each episode is the true story of a woman who, in one way or another, encountered Matrona of Moscow. She appeared to some in dreams, some went to church and prayed, some lost consciousness and Matrona appeared to them...
Stories of life, love, betrayal, infidelity... Matrona helped some mend their relationships with their husbands, and she guided others on the right path in finding a criminal...

name: Почтальон
summary: It's spring in Moscow. The May Day celebrations have just ended, and the country is still reeling from one holiday, preparing for the next – Victory Day. Everyone is in a state of bliss and tranquility, awaiting the warm summer. Only the post office is working hard – letters, cards, newspapers, packages, and parcels are arriving in an endless stream. There aren't enough people, everyone is exhausted, tired, and irritated. The protagonist, a simple postal worker named Gerasim, is also running around like a squirrel in a wheel. Five years ago, he lost his brother, and with him, any hope for justice in this life. One day, one of the old ladies he delivered mail to is murdered. Gerasim begins his own investigation, during which he meets Nastya, a modest girl who becomes both a loyal assistant and a lover. But then, prosecutor Bizyak stands in our heroes' way. The indefatigable postman sticks his nose into everything, for which the law enforcement officer punishes him by jailing him for a while. Some time later, Gerasim is promoted at work, but he asks to postpone his "career advancement" while the investigation continues.

name: Аисты счастья
summary: Marina Leonidova lives with her daughters and mother in a private house in the small town of Yuryatin. Local businessman Kovrov plans to build a shopping center on the site of her house. Kovrov invites Marina and her family to move to a city apartment, but she refuses and intends to fight for her home to the end.

name: Шпионы и предатели
summary: A series of films about the most famous CIA and KGB spies

name: Игры в подкидного
summary:
The recent past—from the beginning of perestroika until almost the present day. A time of turmoil, a period of capital accumulation, showdowns, a reassessment of all old values, the acquisition of new ones...

The film's heroes, along with the entire country, begin a new life in the mid-1980s, swiftly breaking through all the trials the era has in store. They are not constrained by excessive moral principles, but with every step they take in their pursuit of enormous wealth, they take sin upon their souls and are aware of it.

name: Легенды космоса
summary:
Cosmonautics is a great achievement of a great country! On October 4, 1957, the USSR launched the world's first artificial satellite, Sputnik, and less than four years later, the first human spaceflight took place. Over these 55 years, Yuri Gagarin was joined by 119 more cosmonauts. As of March 2016, exactly 120 of our compatriots have contributed to the exploration of space, and each of them is undoubtedly a hero and a legend. Just like the brilliant scientists who brought recent science fiction to life. The "Legends of Space" series is dedicated to these people, as well as to the most significant events in the history of Russian cosmonautics.

This story will not only be about the familiar heroes of the Soviet era—Gagarin, Tereshkova, Titov, Leonov, Grechko, Savitskaya—but also about those who have found themselves beyond the Earth in the 21st century: Russian cosmonauts and scientists. What are these heroes like, not only in orbit but also in their lives on Earth? These are perhaps the two main questions that the "Legends of Space" series will answer.

name: Курская дуга
summary: In April 1943, Stalin received a secret document – a plan for the German Operation Citadel. The Wehrmacht was preparing a large-scale offensive, but the Führer's signature was missing. Could intelligence data and the authenticity of secret documents be trusted? How should the correct decision be made – to attack and attempt to inflict serious damage on the German armies, depriving them of the strength to launch an attack, or to defend and risk the possibility of failing to hold the lines? Nikolai Vatutin insisted that an attack was necessary without delay. Konstantin Rokossovsky insisted that it was essential to hold the line. Why did headquarters accept one point of view and reject the other? Which side did Marshal Zhukov support? The same dilemma – to attack or to defend – tormented the German headquarters. Among the German generals, there were those who even then realized that an attack on the USSR would be a fatal mistake. Why weren't they listened to? How did the newest German tank, the Tiger, end up at the Kubinka testing ground? What kind of blows did its armor withstand, and were its weak points discovered? What other "surprises" did the German military industry have in store, and how did the Soviet army have to defend itself?

name: Подвиг на Халхин-Голе
summary: 2019. Mongolian steppes. Khalkhin Gol. 80 years ago, thousands of Soviet and Mongolian soldiers and officers met their death on this land. Why did they fight the Japanese hundreds of kilometers from the USSR border? Why did the Kwantung Army come from Japan to these steppes? And why is Mongolia still grateful to the Soviet Marshal of Victory Georgy Zhukov? That long-gone conflict at Khalkhin Gol is still viewed differently in Russia, Mongolia, and Japan. But everyone agrees on one thing: the victory of the Soviet-Mongolian forces on these steppes changed the course of world history!

name: Нечисть
summary: A collection of films featuring all the mythical creatures mentioned in legends and stories. The creators of the series traveled around the world, collecting stories and eyewitness accounts.

name: Ребята с нашего двора
summary: Several stories from the lives of children from one yard.

name: Man's Inhumanity to Man
summary: It traces the atrocities of Unit 731's biological and chemical warfare, reflects on history's scars, and prays for humanity's peace.

name: Fan Pai Qian Jin Shang Wei Ji
The 4th Love Revolution
summary: A youth romance that takes place when the Department of Computer Engineering and the Department of Modeling are merged.

name: FER
summary: Dilek, a mother of two who lives apart from her husband but is not yet divorced, works as an unlicensed taxi driver to make a living. One day, she picks up a passenger who's taking an illegal taxi for the first time and they get caught in a police check. After losing her car, Dilek finds herself cornered by pressure from her husband and family during the divorce process. But she refuses to give up. Just when she's about to lose hope, the passenger from that day, Şadi, offers her a job as his driver. Accepting the offer pulls Dilek into a dark and dangerous world, where she will uncover hidden talents and ultimately change her own destiny.

name: Qiyun Dantian: Kaiju Qiandao Zhizun Dantian
Persona
summary: A psychological thriller series that questions the concepts of crime, identity, and reality. The story revolves around a man forced to confront his past and his struggle with his inner self. The main character's inner collapse leads the audience into the dark corridors of the human mind.

name: Дворцы взорвать и уходить...
summary: The film tells the story of the fate of the Tsarskoye Selo palaces from the moment the Romanov family left them until the beginning of the Great Patriotic War.

previousepisode.name: Легенда Царского Села Иван Петрович Саутов

name: The Greatest Average American
summary: The Greatest Average American is a hilarious new game show that celebrates the power of being perfectly average. Each round is packed with laugh-out-loud challenges and trivia as contestants try to guess how everyday Americans think and live. In the end, one lucky player will be crowned the Greatest Average American and get the chance to win the ultimate grand prize: the average American salary of $67,920.

previousepisode.name: The Nate Bargatze Shopping Cart Nestle!

name: Ocean Wild
summary: Discover the underwater landscape where aquatic species have evolved.

name: Eyes In The Woods
summary: The forest watches as two sisters confront personal truths - and what lurks in the dark.

name: MAFS UK Does Come Dine with Me
summary: It's bite at first sight in an iconic union! Culinary competitiveness meets marriage mayhem, as five Married at First Sight UK marvels battle it out to win a £1000 cash prize for charity.

name: Транс-азиатская экспедиция AMAROK
summary: A 6-part documentary project about a grand automobile expedition across the entire Asian continent. Seven countries, 14,000 km, through deserts and mountains. Starting in Astrakhan and finishing in Blagoveshchensk.

name: РОКовая ночь с Александром Ф. Скляром
История русской еды
summary: The documentary series "The History of Russian Food" offers viewers the opportunity to learn so many surprising things about seemingly familiar subjects that they'll rightfully ask: why has Russian television so far ignored the history of national cuisine? For example, is it true that a feast during the time of Ivan the Terrible began with hundreds of roasted swans? Why were Russian medieval feasts criticized by foreigners? How was the monarch protected from poisoning? Or how did the concept of "tipping" come into being? What did "drinking from someone's face" mean? What did lean years mean for Rus'? How did Russians escape the famine caused by crop failure? And, in general, how did Russian cuisine develop and evolve over the centuries? Where did certain foods originate that have become an integral part of the national menu? Why have so many foods and drinks disappeared from our lives? What kind of dish is "perm," and where did the strange saying "No problem – quinoa" come from?

name: Холод
summary: Cold. We encounter it every day. But we still don't know what it is we're really dealing with. What threat does global warming pose to the world? Why did they try to build an aircraft carrier out of ice during World War II? What can frozen water samples recovered from subglacial Lake Vostok tell scientists? How has cold influenced the birth and destruction of entire civilizations? Two years of filming took place around the world – in Russia, Norway, the UK, the US, and, of course, on the coldest continent on the planet. What did it look like before? Is it true that Antarctica's ice is slowly melting? The filmmakers sought answers to these questions on expeditions and in research labs, where they conducted complex experiments. "Without ice and snow, there would be no ocean currents; the oceans would be deprived of oxygen, meaning there would be no life. The presence of ice determines the temperature difference between the poles and the equatorial regions; this temperature difference generates air currents in the atmosphere that shape the planet's climate," explains Magnus Magnusson, Scientific Secretary of the International Glaciological Society. "In short, life on Earth would be impossible without cold, snow, and ice."

name: В поисках НЛО
summary: Does extraterrestrial intelligence exist, or is it just a figment of science fiction? In search of an answer, a film crew travels to eight of the planet's most mysterious locations where alien contact signals have been reported.

name: Марк Захаров: мое настоящее, прошлое и будущее
С новым счастьем!
summary: Husbands sometimes leave their wives, and wives sometimes leave their husbands. That's life. For some, it's a relief; for others, it's a tragedy. For the film's heroine, the separation from her husband was a huge stress, as she had been selflessly in love with her chosen one. Her friends offer various ways to get her husband back, but none of them work for our heroine—she's fundamentally incapable of lying or pretending. And most importantly, she'll never be able to deceive herself. The woman understands well that love is dead and there's nothing she can do about it. But it's true that the most incredible wishes come true on New Year's. And the abandoned wife learns this firsthand—just when she thought life had lost all meaning.

name: Англия в общем и в частности
summary: Hosts Vladimir Pozner and Ivan Urgant go to England to tell about the magnificent pages of history and modernity of the largest administrative unit of the UK state.

name: Женщины и прочие неприятности
summary: The story of four women who lost their husbands under very strange circumstances. Desperate for justice, the widows band together to find the killer themselves. They support each other, because life has not stopped. The business left behind by their deceased husbands requires management, and problems arise that the women will have to solve on their own. In addition, they meet other men along the way, and the women must discover whether it is possible to find happiness again.

name: Арбатские мальчики
summary: A series about the fate of one of Moscow's most celebrated districts – Arbat Street and its surrounding area. The very word "Arbat" has become a symbol of intelligence, masculinity, and decency. The development of this remarkable district is traced through generations of "Arbat boys," beginning with Lermontov and Herzen. A unifying theme is the life of one of the most famous "Arbat boys" of the 20th century – artist Boris Birger, a friend of many Arbat residents, from Okudzhava to Sakharov. Through his life and work, the common traits of the "Arbat character" are revealed.

previousepisode.name: С послевоенных лет до 90-х годов XX века

name: Непредвиденные визиты
summary: Recently elected mayor Selivanov visits his predecessors, learning about their difficult lives. The stories of these former mayors about themselves and their lives, closely intertwined with the country's history, form the basis of this four-part series. The former mayor tells the current mayor about a tragic event that befell him. Sedykh's son, a tenth-grade student, created an underground organization, which he used to terrorize the entire school. In doing so, he clearly copied the practices his father had established in the executive committee. Sedykh learned of the incident from his teacher, Galina Chernyaeva, and, fearing a scandal, suggested that she hush up the matter. Chernyaeva refused. The conflict between the all-powerful mayor and the teacher ended unexpectedly: they fell in love.

name: Месяц длинных дней
summary: A film about the lives, characters, and attitudes of workers at a large printing house, who combine work with treatment and rest in a sanatorium.

name: Трое сверху
summary:
The story is about how two young, attractive girls, Sveta and Tanya, who live in rented apartment No. 7 on the second floor of an apartment building in Moscow, are forced to look for a third tenant who would share all the utility costs with them. They come across a handsome guy named Kostya, who is also an excellent cook, as he is studying to become a chef.

The only obstacle to their happy alliance is the apartment owner, Semyon Kuzmich, who lives with his wife, Inna Pavlovna, on the floor below; they are both pensioners. Their views on life are, to put it mildly, old‑fashioned, and their declared morality borders on militant hypocrisy. The girls have to resort to a trick – they convince the owner that the guy is gay.

name: Старшеклассники
summary: Four main characters with different interests, future plans and problems are studying at the same school. They are not children anymore, but not adults yet. Before starting a grown up life each of them needs to make important decisions.

name: Война и Мир
summary: A seven-hour epic adaptation of the novel by Leo Tolstoy. The love story of young Countess Natasha Rostova and Count Pierre Bezukhov is interwoven with the Great Patriotic War of 1812 against Napoleon's invading army.

name: Чтобы помнили
summary: The author's cycle of the famous theater and film actor Leonid Filatov, dedicated to the actors of Soviet and Russian cinema who passed away. Aleksandr Kaidanovsky and Rolan Bykov, Vladimir Vysotsky and Innokenty Smoktunovsky, Oleg Dal and Inna Gulaya became heroes of the issues - and many others.The last program was dedicated to the author himself and the presenter - Leonid Filatov. She aired on December 4, 2003. The filming of the documentary cycle was completed due to the death of the presenter.

name: Лучшая дорога нашей жизни
summary: The film tells about the beginning of the construction of the Baikal-Amur Mainline.

name: Маяковский. Два дня
summary: A story about the last two days of Mayakovsky's life and some episodes of the previous time.

name: Последний бронепоезд
summary: The film is based on real events, happened in the beginning of WW2 in august 1941 in Belorussia.

name: Я все преодолею
summary: Luda is a strong woman who carries an exorbitant burden on fragile shoulders. She fights with her husband's drunkenness, brings up children, helps her friend and patiently stomachs her mother-in-law. But fate seems to test the heroine for strength, and the next blow is not a small-time trouble, but a real tragedy. Luda's husband tragically dies in a fire, and the house burns down. As if running amuck, her close ones drop their masks and betray the heroine - the mother-in-law refuses to give her shelter, and the best friend drives her into the street out of stupid jealousy. Will Luda be able to overcome all misfortunes and start life anew?

name: Агент национальной безопасности
summary: The adventures of the special agent Aleksey Nikolaev.

name: Оперативный псевдоним
summary: In a small provincial town Tikhodonsk a former patient of mental hospital Sergey Lapin lives and he seems to be a quiet, modest man, although local people know that this weird man who lives together with a market seller, in fact is not that simple. Sergey is strong and emotional, and his anger can't be controlled by his consciousness. His life becomes different after he was run over by a head of technical support of the bank. Then bank officers realize that they can use his knowledge of new security systems, so they hire him. He gets his first salary and buys some new clothing - Sergey changes so amazingly. Smart chief of bank's security tests Sergey to find out other hidden resources of this person. Still, the man does not remember anything that could shed some light to his mystic past. But there are those who know about the danger this person can bring. They open the hunting season on Lapin, who decides to solve the mystery and get back his forgotten self.

name: Чужая война
summary: The military operations taking place in the years 1965-1973 when a group of Russian military operatives carried out the advisory support of North Vietnam as well as covert operations to capture the spoils (the enemy's new war technologies) It is the story of a soldier named Paul who was sent from Moscow military school in Vietnam where he discovers a traitor among his colleagues. However, through a turn of events, he becomes a traitor in the eyes of the commander, and he has to run from his comrades to complete the operation and prove that he is not guilty. Along the way, he joins forces with a North Vietnamese man and an escaped military pilot. The three men make a plan to leave the territory of Vietnam but the road to freedom is full of dangers and surprises. In the end, Paul finds the original traitor and destroys him but he still has to prove his innocence.

name: Ладога
summary: The Second World War. Leningrad was in blockade in the winter of 1941. The only way to deliver food and other supplies to the city is through the icy Lake Ladoga, the so-called "Road of Life". The path itself passes through the ice of the lake. But the Nazis are preparing a diversion along the way, and their informant is most likely a truck driver. To deal with this situation entrusted to the captain of the NKVD Sergienko.

name: Зворыкин-Муромец
summary: Biopic about Russian engineer Vladimir Zvorykin, the inventor of television.

name: Котовский
summary: This film tells the story of the early years of the famous Soviet commander, Grigoriy Kotovskiy, during the decline of tsarism in Russia. As a student at agricultural college in 1900, Kotovskiy meets a group of graduates who pledge eternal friendship and loyalty to one another even though their lives quickly take very different paths. While Oles becomes a politician, and Aleksey rises to the rank of Police Commander, Viktor turns to a life of crime together with his friend, Grigoriy Kotovskiy, who becomes leader of a gang of robbers. As a youth Kotovskiy is headstrong, romantic and impetuous. Robbing the rich to give to the poor, he becomes known as the Robin Hood of Bessarabia, held in awe by everyone throughout Southern Russia. With a price on his head, it is only a matter of time before he is captured and sent to prison. But he manages to escape and soon returns to his already legendary life of crime. Encountering both true love and treachery along the way, Kotovskiy continues to uphold his own strict code of conduct honoring the promise once given to his friends.

name: Чудо техники
summary: The latest scientific developments and technologies that are capable of changing or are already changing our lives.

name: Личное счастье
summary: Saga about the Doroshins family. The action takes place in the war and post-war time. The characteristic features of the Doroshins family are hard work, courage and integrity. Pavel Nikolaevich - war veteran, chief designer of the plant, Anastasiya Mikhaylovna - head of Department of the University, an active participant in the partisan movement. Their eldest son, Ilya, a sanitary doctor, demands the liquidation of one of the enterprises in the city center. But war criminals, hiding from retaliation, know that the Gestapo archives are hidden in the basement of the building, and are afraid that documents may be discovered.

name: Бабочки и птицы
summary: From the side of Olga's life, every woman could envy - a clever beauty, a wonderful husband, a loving son, her work. But the rich, as you know, also cry, and behind this picture of a happy life you cannot see what Olga does not have - love. Quite by chance, in the classroom at the equestrian club, Olga met the handsome and gallant Victor, who turned out to be a technologist.

name: След Пираньи
summary: The story begins with Mazur's personal tragedy - his wife Olga is killed. Mazur finds out that the murderer of his wife is the owner of a hunting zaimka, where they arrange a hunt ... for people. Mazur intends to take revenge, but it is almost impossible to get to the killer. Mazur turns to his old friend General Glagolev for help. He is ready to help if the captain fulfills his task. There are videos on the hunting zaimka that compromise a US senator running for president. Mazur must get these materials for the American prosecutor, who intends to expose the senator.

name: Rauta-aika
summary: Väinö, Ilmari and Lemminki, inspired by the tales in the Kalevala, go in search of a woman, eventually finding themselves at war with the Nordic people, and consider the great questions of life, their relationship to life, love and death.

name: Тещины блины
summary: Sveta and Dima live in a wonderful town Blinov, in the touristic center of Russia. They both are about thirty, and they have two lovely kids: a seven-year-old Sanya and a toddler Lena. Sveta's mom, beautiful but lonely business-lady, owns a ceramic shop. Her daughter works there drawing traditional ornaments on cups and plates. Dima is a talented chef. But he loses his job again and again because of his culinary experiments and intolerance to violations of the quality and quantity of products. Dima does not give up: he still cooks pancakes for his friends and dreams about a restaurant on the riverside of Volga. Sveta is tired of instability and lack of money. And Olga doesn't like her son in law: she thinks that such a romantic looser doesn't suit her daughter. Unlike Petya, Sveta's classmate - he is a lawyer and seems to be successful. But one lucky day Sveta wins a lottery - almost 3 millions! She does not tell her husband about her unexpected wealth. All the money she won ... she invests into new restaurant. And this decision will cause a lot of problems for our heroes.

name: Тур де Франс
summary: Travel of Vladimir Pozner and Ivan Urgant in France.

name: Квартирка
summary: Olga and Igor have been married for a long time, they have an adult daughter Masha. Nothing foreshadowed changes in their small Moscow apartment, until Igor became interested in his daughter's girlfriend, Ksyusha. Olga behaved decisively - put Igor out of the door and filed for divorce. Igor was forced to move in with his chosen one and her imposing mother Irina, his age. But soon he had to return to his wife's apartment. And then Masha fell in love, and, as luck would have it, her boyfriend Kirill turned out to be a nonresident. Living together in close quarters forces the heroes to look for an unusual way out of the situation. Parents decide to sacrifice themselves for the sake of their daughter's happiness and begin to look for new life partners who are not burdened with the "apartment issue".

name: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry
summary:
Professor Hannah Fry sets off on a global adventure, not just to see the world but to decode it. With curiosity, wit and insight she peels back the layers in six iconic locations: Spain, Vietnam, Greece, South Korea, Ireland, and Iceland.

Through stunning landscapes, vibrant cities and off the beaten track treasures, Hannah seeks out extraordinary local voices and unexpected quirks of history and geography that reveal what makes each place truly unique. Always seeking patterns and hidden connections, she uncovers how Spain's destiny was shaped by mountains, analyses traffic etiquette in Ho Chi Minh City, reveals secrets hidden in the geometry at the Parthenon and how Irish syntax builds a world view.

This is much more than a travelogue—it's a journey into the forces that shape nations and define cultures.

name: The Eggheads
summary: A lighthearted look at student life with Bryan, Peter, Bob, and Vivien who share a flat in London.

name: Die Unzerquizbaren
summary: In four rounds, several candidates compete against each other and simultaneously against the supposedly ‘unquizzable' Elton and Stefan Raab, who, however, always have to agree on an answer. Gradually, the number of challengers decreases until only the best remains to face the two entertainers in a direct final duel. Whoever manages to defeat Elton and Stefan Raab can win up to 100,000 euros.

name: Once a Doctor, Always a Doctor
summary: Following an incident that makes him question his future as a doctor, cardiothoracic surgeon Dr. Talodkarn decides to go provide government services in Yala. A twist of fate, however, lands him back at his previous hospital.

previousepisode.name: Как лепной горшок ценнее клада оказался

name: Абсолютный слух
summary: The almanac on the history of musical culture "Absolute Pitch" is an educational and engaging TV magazine that covers various musical styles and trends, genres and eras. The range of topics is extremely diverse: from the origins of a popular song to the history of creating a major musical masterpiece, from the nuances of opera or ballet productions to the biographies of outstanding composers and performers. The program is designed for the widest possible audience of music professionals and enthusiasts.

name: А.С. Пушкин. Тысяча строк о любви
summary: Valentin Nepomnyashchy's author's programme. The cycle is a lyrical confession by Alexander Sergeyevich Pushkin. By reading the poet's verses and providing explanations and remarks, the author shows how the poet's ideas about love, about women, about himself, about creativity, and about life develop — for love was for Pushkin a matter of life and death, the meaning of existence, the essence of creativity, and the purpose of human life. The cycle covers the entire creative life of Pushkin, starting from 1813.

name: La coleccionista
summary: In a border town, Fátima "The Collector" gives visitors objects from her eerie shop. These seemingly ordinary gifts harbor hidden supernatural powers.

name: 1812-1815. Заграничный поход
summary: 2012 marked the 200th anniversary of the Battle of Borodino and the expulsion of Napoleonic troops from the Russian Empire. The film continues the theme of the Patriotic War of 1812 and invites viewers to remember the events of 1813-1815, which are less known to a wider audience. This is a story about the path traveled by the Russian army from the burning of Moscow to Paris: about the battles of Dresden and Kulm, about the defeat of the French near Leipzig, about the military actions of Russian troops in France. The viewer will learn the details of Napoleon's abdication and his first exile to the island of Elba, the unexpected return of the French emperor, the hundred days of his reign and the final defeat of his army...

A large-scale reconstruction of the heroic events of the Patriotic War of 1812, in which Russia defeated Napoleonic France. The 4-episode project "1812" covers the main events of the war with Napoleon from the summer to the winter of 1812 - from the moment when the "great army" invaded the Russian Empire, until the moment when its remnants were driven back.

name: Бабушка на сносях
summary: Kira, a charming and young-looking woman, marries her adult son and will soon become a grandmother. She is surrounded by good people, and at her job, too, everything is wonderful - In a word, everything is fine, except for personal life.. At the wedding, Kira presents to her son and his wife a week in an elite hotel, but the circumstances are such that the newlyweds are unable to go. As a result a lonely middle-aged lady checks into a honeymoon suite instead of a couple - the good trip can't go to waste. In this romantic atmosphere, Kira has a passionate and light affair herself. And everything would be fine, but having returned home happy Kira, to her utmost horror, discovers that she is pregnant..

name: Черный ворон
summary: A Russian mystery drama series based on the book of the same name by Dmitriy Veresov.

name: Их Италия
summary: The hosts meet at the dinner table with famous Italians. They tell the hosts about the main sights of Italy and the most significant local dishes and drinks. After that, the hosts visit the named places and taste these dishes.

name: Смерть шпионам!
summary: August 1944. The Soviet Department of Military Counterespionage is trying to identify an enemy secret agent. Dramatic events unfold as it becomes clear that the spy is one of the Soviet army's own men.

name: Две сестры
summary: A romantic story about love between Varya, figure skating world champion, and Vladimir, ice hockey star.

name: Вижу-знаю
summary: The operatives of one of the police departments are on the trail of dangerous criminals every day. They face violent gangsters and uncover intricate combinations invented by criminals to cover up crimes. But each of the police officers of the department knows that there is always a reliable shoulder of a colleague nearby.

name: Не жалею, не зову, не плачу
Трое против всех
summary: After their father is lost at sea and their mother falls into a coma, three young siblings struggle against all to hold their family together.

name: Агент
summary: The secret agent of the special services, Andrei Kozyrev, nicknamed the American, unjustly convicted of murder, once has a chance to change his life. He makes a daring escape from the colony to find his enemy, prove his innocence and save the world from a deadly new virus that threatens the death of millions of people.

name: Банды
summary: Based on the real story. After collapse of USSR former army officer don't know what to do with his life in new Russia. After some collisions with criminals he decided to join a gang by his own will.

name: Toronto Airport Uncovered
summary: For the first time, cameras go behind the scenes at Toronto Pearson International, Canada's biggest and busiest airport. They reveal how the airport keeps millions of passengers and thousands of planes moving, even when facing record-breaking snowstorms and extreme winter weather. Technical issues, emergencies, security breaches and passenger demands pile even more pressure on the flight schedule.

name: Дорогая передача
summary: A Russian sketch comedy show. The predecessor of "6 kadrov".

name: Анна Каренина
summary: Anna is torn between her love to Count Vronsky, and her loveless marriage to Mr. Karenin. Based on the book by Leo Tolstoy.

name: Анна Павлова
summary: The film is based on the biography of the legendary Russian ballerina Anna Pavlova. She became an internationally regarded ballerina after her performances in 1909 with the Dyaghilev's Ballet in Paris and in London. Anna Pavlova eventually formed her own troupe. She made a successful world tour together with Viktor d'Andre, who was her husband and manager.

name: Настоящие Детективы
summary: Zhenya Utopia and a unique experiment in which celebrity guests investigate murders, interrogate suspects, and sift through evidence. They are detectives whose job it is to find the culprits and uncover their motives. And it's not easy, as criminals are adept at covering their tracks.
